Title: Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB serverless container with 1 TB storage

Body.Content:
We're excited to announce that Azure Cosmos DB serverless now supports up to 1 TB of storage in a single container. This means that you can deploy serverless containers without worrying about running out of storage capacity or throughput.
With the expanded storage capacity, you'll also enjoy increased RU/s burstability of the container. This means that as your storage needs grow, the performance of your container will automatically scale to meet those needs. Plus, the burstability scales linearly with the storage, ensuring that you're always getting the best possible performance from your serverless containers.
Try out Azure Cosmos DB serverless with expanded storage today and experience the power and scalability of a fully managed NoSQL database service.
